scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client)
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run --workspace client build --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration --workspace server
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
